name: SparkPost
description: Email transmissions, templates, message events, deliverability metrics, domains, and administration through the SparkPost API.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned regional API key, optionally pin a subaccount, select capabilities, and let agents inspect or transmit under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: SPARKPOST_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: SparkPost API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-owned key with only the grants agents need.

credentialRequirements.name: SPARKPOST_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: SparkPost region
credentialRequirements.helpText: US or EU; the regional accounts and API origins are independent.

credentialRequirements.name: SPARKPOST_SENDER_DOMAIN
credentialRequirements.label: Verified sender domain
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact verified domain agents may transmit from.

capabilities.label: Account
capabilities.description: Read bounded account metadata when the key grant permits it.

capabilities.label: Message events
capabilities.description: Search bounded delivery and engagement events.

capabilities.label: Transmissions
capabilities.description: Create transmissions through the bound sender domain.

capabilities.label: Full SparkPost API
capabilities.description: Use all endpoints allowed by the customer key within its region and subaccount.

allowed.label: Read message events
allowed.description: Search a bounded time window of message events.

approvalRequired.label: Create transmission
approvalRequired.description: Creating a transmission requires approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Use full SparkPost API
approvalRequired.description: All other API operations require approval in Safe mode.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; transmissions and all other API operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected key-authorized capability runs without Relay per-action approvals; ownership, regional/subaccount authority, sender binding, provider grants/limits, secret isolation, bounded evidence, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected SparkPost tools and proxies the key server-side.
Railway mounts selected SparkPost tools and proxies the key server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates a least-privilege regional key and enters it with the verified sender domain and optional subaccount.

evidence.supports: SparkPost uses customer API keys, independent US/EU v1 origins, 420 sending-limit and 429 rate-limit responses.
Customers create one-time-visible keys with chosen permissions and optional subaccount constraints.
Message events support explicit UTC windows and cursor pagination; Relay bounds typed reads to 100 events and seven days.
Transmissions accept inline recipients or stored lists and impose a 20 MB content limit.
Subaccount keys isolate domains, reporting data, events, and transmission grants.
